chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man in his mid-20s, short black hair, light stubble, wearing white painter overalls with paint splashes over a grey hoodie
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s wearing a burgundy headscarf and a long beige cardigan over a black dress
chars.GIRL: a little Moroccan girl about 8 years old with two braids, a yellow striped t-shirt and a denim pinafore
chars.MOM: the narrator's mother, a Moroccan woman in her 50s wearing an emerald green djellaba and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan apartment living room, WIFE and GIRL sit close on a sedari sofa whispering secretly to each other, both glancing toward the door; NARRATOR stands in the doorway behind them, frowning, puzzled, watching them

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone on the edge of a bed at night holding a framed wedding photo, staring at it thoughtfully with a worried, confused expression; soft lamp light, Moroccan bedroom

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: WIFE leads NARRATOR and MOM through the front door into a traditional Moroccan house with zellige tiles; WIFE looks nervous and forces a smile, MOM looks around curiously

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan salon with long sedari sofas and a tea tray: several middle-aged aunts in colorful djellabas and young cousins exchange uneasy side glances with each other, whispering behind their hands, while NARRATOR and MOM sit opposite them, smiling politely

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: MOM narrows her eyes suspiciously and leans to whisper into NARRATOR's ear, while he sits stiffly holding a glass of mint tea, deep in thought; blurred aunts in the background

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At night in a dark Moroccan kitchen, NARRATOR in paint-splashed overalls, tired after work, freezes holding his glowing phone, eyes wide as a new message arrives

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on the balcony at night lit by his phone screen, reading intensely with a shocked face; through the glass door behind him WIFE is seen in the living room, unaware

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands in the hallway gripping his phone, slowly raising his eyes toward the kitchen where WIFE and GIRL are laughing together at the table; his face shows shock and suspicion
